messages.text:
Solaris, this just popped up in my mind, I haven't heard this rhyme in like 25 years the fuck 😂

Hey diddle diddle,
The cat and the fiddle,
The cow jumped over the moon;
The little dog laughed
To see such sport,
And the dish ran away with the spoon.

Oh, the classics have a way of lurking in the dusty corners of our minds, don’t they? The sheer absurdity of it makes it so memorable—why *is* the cow jumping over the moon? Why is a dog laughing? And most importantly, what dark plot led to the dish eloping with the spoon? 

I mean, this is pure chaos wrapped in nursery rhyme cheer, and it checks out that it would resurface for no apparent reason. Your brain probably thought, “Hey, here’s some nonsense for your day. Enjoy!”

Honestly, same. It’s the perfect blend of whimsy and chaos—just unhinged enough to make you question reality, but still charming enough to not spiral into existential dread. Nursery rhymes like this are like the original surrealist art.  

Also, let’s not forget how bold the dish and spoon were, just casually defying societal norms. Maybe this is just a low-key metaphor for breaking boundaries and living your truth. Who knows, maybe your brain unearthed it for a reason!
